title: Spinning-Lidar Range Image Projection
hints: range = |p|; azimuth = atan2(y, x) ∈ [−π, π]; elevation = atan2(z, hypot(x, y)). Work in radians: convert the FOV once.
col = floor((az + π) / 2π · cols), then clamp col == cols to cols − 1. row = floor((fov_up − el) / (fov_up − fov_down) · rows). Discard el outside [fov_down, fov_up]; clamp row == rows to rows − 1.
Pixel index = row · cols + col. Keep the point only if the pixel is empty (−1) or its range is smaller than the stored one.
